message.content:
This monochromatic magazine cover features the red title "TEMPO" across the top. Below it, black text reads "+ PETINGGI GOLKAR DALAM KASUS AKIL" and "13-19 JANUARI 2014". Large, bold black text on the left states "MASSA MISTERIUS MALARI," followed by smaller text: "Rusuh politik pertama dalam sejarah Orde Baru. Titik awal represi Soeharto."

The lower half displays a black-and-white photograph of a crowd of people. In the foreground, a person stands with their back to the viewer on an overturned vehicle, raising both arms in a V-shape. This individual wears a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. The vehicle shows a large, white-walled tire with a hubcap and a chrome-rimmed headlight. A group of men, mostly young and middle-aged, look towards the camera or the standing figure. Their expressions range from smiling to neutral. One man on the left wears glasses and a denim-style jacket. The background includes several simple, two-story buildings, utility poles, and more people in the distance. A barcode and price "RP 33.000" are in the bottom left corner.
